content.title: 'Euphoria' Red Carpet Photos: Zendaya, Jacob Elordi & More
content.text: Skip to main content ‘Euphoria’ Season 3 Premiere Red Carpet Photos: Zendaya, Jacob Elordi, Sydney Sweeney, Hunter Schafer & More (L-R) Hunter Schafer, Jacob Elordi, Zendaya, Sydney Sweeney and Maude Apatow Getty Images Euphoria celebrated its Season 3 premiere at the TCL Chinese Theatre in Los Angeles, where the stars of the HBO series were present. Zendaya, Jacob Elordi, Sydney Sweeney, Hunter Schafer, and more walked down the red carpet for the highly anticipated return of the series, which could also be its last. Also on the red carpet were Maude Apatow, Nika King, Natasha Lyonne, Brian Grazer, Da’Vine Joy Randolph, Alexa Demie, among many others. RELATED: Zendaya Hints At ‘Euphoria’ Ending After Season 3: “Closure Is Coming” Euphoria Season 3 is set to premiere on April 12 on HBO and stream on HBO Max. Returning actors include Zendaya, Hunter Schafer, Eric Dane, Jacob Elordi, Sydney Sweeney, Alexa Demie, Maude Apatow, Martha Kelly, Chloe Cherry, Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje, and Toby Wallace. Returning guest stars include Colman Domingo, Nika King, Alanna Ubach, Sophia Rose Wilson, Melvin Bonez Estes, Daeg Faerch, Paula Marshall, Zak Steiner, and Marsha Gambles. RELATED: Everything We Know About Season 3 Of ‘Euphoria’ So Far Notable guest actors appearing in Season 3 include Sharon Stone, Rosalía, Danielle Deadwyler, Marshawn Lynch, Anna Van Patten, Asante Blackk, Bella Podaras, Bill Bodner, Cailyn Rice, Christopher Ammanuel, Kadeem Hardison, Kwame Patterson, Natasha Lyonne, among many others. RELATED: ‘Euphoria’: Rue Gets Interrogated By DEA Agents In Latest Season 3 Trailer Season 3 is understood to be the last season, although HBO Chief Casey Bloys didn’t rule out going beyond it, as creator Sam Levinson has an idea for a potential fourth season. “What’s happening is Sam is finishing the third season, which I will say he’s come up with an incredible way to move all these characters ahead five years, it’s really exciting to see,” Bloys told Deadline earlier this year. “We’re just starting to see the cuts, which are great. But in terms of what he wants to do next, we will have a conversation about what he’s thinking. But right now, he’s focused on finishing three and getting it out.” Scroll through the photo gallery below to see all the stars at the Euphoria Season 3 premiere.
